# IATA - International Air Transport Association

> IATA is the global trade association representing 360 airlines, setting standards and policies for aviation safety, sustainability, cargo operations, and passenger experience.

IATA serves as the primary industry body for commercial aviation, established in 1945. The organization develops standards, advocates for airline interests, and coordinates initiatives across cargo, passenger services, distribution, and sustainability.

## Key Topics

- Aviation Industry Standards
- Airline Membership & IOSA Certification
- Cargo Operations & Supply Chain
- Passenger Experience & One ID
- Sustainability & Environmental Initiatives
- Air Transport Policy & Advocacy
- Airline Distribution & Payment Solutions
- Safety & Security Protocols
- Corporate Governance
- Regional Operations
- Digital Innovation
- Taxation & Currency Repatriation
- Diversity & Inclusion
- World Air Transport Summit
- Strategic Partnerships

## Organization Overview

- [IATA - Home](https://www.iata.org): IATA homepage with aviation industry news, standards, and sustainability initiatives
- [IATA - About Us](https://www.iata.org/en/about): Overview of IATA as trade association representing 360 airline members globally
- [IATA - Vision & Mission](https://www.iata.org/en/about/mission): IATA's mission, vision and values guiding the organization's airline member services
- [IATA - Priorities](https://www.iata.org/en/about/priorities): IATA board-defined priorities for air traffic, sustainability, and consumer regulation
- [IATA - IATA by Region](https://www.iata.org/en/about/worldwide): IATA regional offices and priorities across Africa, Asia Pacific, Europe

## Membership & Governance

- [IATA - Membership](https://www.iata.org/en/about/members): IATA airline membership benefits, requirements and IOSA safety audit standards
- [IATA - Corporate Governance](https://www.iata.org/en/about/corporate-structure): IATA corporate governance structure, board documentation and bylaws
- [IATA - IATA Management](https://www.iata.org/en/about/management): IATA senior management and leadership team including Director General Willie Walsh
- [IATA - Strategic Partnerships](https://www.iata.org/en/about/sp): Strategic Partnerships Program for aviation suppliers and service providers

## Core Programs & Operations

- [IATA - Programs & Policy](https://www.iata.org/en/programs): Overview of IATA programs including cargo, safety, security and digital innovation
- [IATA - Cargo](https://www.iata.org/en/programs/cargo): IATA cargo programs for safe, secure and sustainable air cargo supply chain
- [IATA - Passenger Experience & Policy](https://www.iata.org/en/programs/passenger): IATA passenger experience standards including One ID and baggage handling
- [IATA - Distribution, Payment & Taxation](https://www.iata.org/en/programs/airline-distribution): IATA airline distribution, payment solutions and currency repatriation initiatives

## Sustainability & Commitment

- [IATA - Our Commitment](https://www.iata.org/en/about/our-commitment): IATA sustainability, diversity, equality and business ethics commitments

## Store & Services

- [IATA Store - Store](https://www.iata.org/en/store): IATA online store for products, customer portal and member account management

## Optional

- [IATA - History](https://www.iata.org/en/about/history): IATA's 75+ year history since founding in Havana in 1945
- [IATA - Careers](https://www.iata.org/en/about/careers): IATA career opportunities and recruitment with diversity and inclusion focus
- [IATA - Speaker Request Form](https://www.iata.org/en/about/speaker-request-form): Form to request IATA employee speakers for events
